exceptions.reason: The other rows of this family that wait on parts of Menu name this file as their target. The file thus stays absent until the last of those parts exists. Its case needs only `ContextMenu.Item`.

exceptions.title: returns focus to the focused surface when closing with Shift+Tab
exceptions.reason: The case closes the menu with the Tab key. The list navigation of the menu root closes a menu for Tab and for Shift+Tab, and it gives the focus back to the trigger. `Menu.Root` has no list navigation yet, so the key does not close the menu.

exceptions.title: keeps the root menu open when the context-menu gesture ends in a portaled submenu
exceptions.reason: The trigger lacks the check of the root owner id at the `mouseup`, which needs `findRootOwnerId` of Menu. Vase UI does not have that file yet, so a `mouseup` in a submenu closes the menu.

The row gives the default `'bottom'`. The part has no Vue default: a prop that is absent lets `Menu.Positioner` take `'bottom'` for a root context menu and `'inline-end'` for a submenu, as in Base UI. Only an absent `side` gives a root context menu the offsets `-5` and `2`. With a Vue default, a submenu opens below its trigger and a root context menu loses those offsets.
